summary: State Bank of India (SBI) is recruiting Specialist Cadre Officers for the post of Assistant Manager – Engineer (Fire) on a regular basis. There are 17 regular vacancies available across India. Eligible candidates with an Engineering degree in Fire Safety or equivalent, aged between 21 and 40 years, can apply online.
eligibility_bullets: Minimum Age: 21 years, Maximum Age: 40 years as on 31.10.2026.

Educational Qualification: B.E. (Fire) from National Fire Service College (NFSC) Nagpur OR B.E./B.Tech (Safety & Fire Engineering) OR B.E./B.Tech (Fire Technology & Safety Engineering) OR equivalent 4-year degree in Fire Safety from UGC recognized University/AICTE approved institution OR Graduate member of Institution of Fire Engineers (India/UK) OR Divisional Officers course from NFSC, Nagpur.

Experience: Minimum 2 years in fire safety for B.E./B.Tech holders, or minimum 3 years as Station Officer/equivalent for Graduate members of Institution of Fire Engineers/Divisional Officers course holders, as on 31.10.2026.
how_to_apply_steps: Register online through the link available on the SBI website.
Scan and upload your latest photograph, signature, and left-hand thumb impression.
Fill in the application form carefully, save if needed, and submit.
Pay the application fee online using Internet Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card.
Take a printout of the system-generated online application form and e-receipt for future reference.

Upload all required documents including resume, ID proof, age proof, caste certificate (if applicable), educational certificates, experience certificates, Form-16/Offer Letter/Latest Salary slip, and a hand-written declaration.
